chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever arrives at the Sacred Monument (Mash'ar al-Haram) and upon it are five from the people, before the sun declines, then he has accomplished the Hajj.

key_terms.أَدْرَكَ الْحَجَّ: Accomplished the Hajj, indicating the validity of the ritual.
key_terms.الْمَشْعَرَ الْحَرَامَ: The Sacred Monument (Mash'ar al-Haram), a specific station in Mina where pilgrims stand in prayer.
key_terms.تَزُولَ الشَّمْسُ: The decline of the sun, referring to the time when the sun passes its zenith (Zawal).
key_terms.خَمْسَةٌ: Five, referring to the minimum number of people required to be present.

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number of people required at Mash'ar al-Haram for the Hajj to be valid?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the minimum quorum required for the validity of the Wuquf (standing) at Mash'ar al-Haram, emphasizing that the presence of five other pilgrims alongside the individual suffices for the ritual to be complete. This ruling highlights the communal nature of Hajj rites while providing practical flexibility for travelers or those in remote areas, ensuring the Hajj is not invalidated by minor logistical delays before the sun declines.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who arrives at the Sacred Monuments and upon it are (at least) five from the people (remaining), before the (start of the) decline of the sun, so he has accomplished the Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Faddal from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
one who attends al-Mash‘ar al-Haram when there still are five people and it is before Zawal (declining of the sun toward the west at noontime) he has attended al-Hajj. ‘“
